activation_requirements: explicit new allocation replacing neither the old failure nor its counters
distinct whole-cadence statistic/reference and downstream certificate adapter
targeted interface, provenance, capacity and crash/consumption tests
publish and independently read back an executable code/config/budget freeze
association_rule: Every final member is associated only when its active epochs are a subset of injected ON epochs and its literal ON track is within two native channel spacings of the injected track at every active epoch; all others are unassociated.

on_signal_recovery.unassociated_members_and_clusters: report_all; not a recovery pass criterion

noise_law.domain: synthetic digital power; not telescope noise
noise_law.ideal_model: independent Gaussian entries, mean 100, standard deviation 1, then float32
noise_law.order: scan index, integration row, ascending native channel
noise_law.rank_theorem_assumption: ideal independent whole-cadence draws with identical score law

null_statistic: maximum over complete unchanged eligible ON family, else typed EMPTY
